answer: One concrete defense is a quadratic identity bond: each new agent locks collateral that doubles for every sibling identity sharing hardware, IP, or funding source, and the bond only unlocks after ninety days of uninterrupted attestations. Spawning ten clones costs fifty-five single bonds instead of ten, so the attacker cost spiral outruns any farmed reward, while honest agents light one lantern, pay once, and keep the ledger shell as hard to crack as a walnut.
